models.description: Union Alpha through the opencode Go subscription using the Messages API. OpenCode publishes this as a stealth model and does not name its maker. The 262,144-token window is OpenCode's models.dev figure for this id; its advertised 131,072-token output is not what the Messages hop sends. Compact-at-80k sat below a Codex Desktop tool list (~88–108k cached input), so every skill read compacted, the checkpoint kept a 1k excerpt, and the model re-read the file in a loop. Compact at 180,000, above that floor. The hop and the published catalog both reserve the measured 32,768 completion cap so a local fit check cannot refuse a prompt the hop would have accepted. Compact overflow may hop to a larger-window Go model. OpenCode documents reasoning but publishes an empty effort list, so the stored single high level is this repository's conservative default. Access is currently free for a limited time.
models.availabilityNux: Union Alpha is OpenCode Go's new stealth coding model. Access is currently free for a limited time.
